timing_source: Actual mGBA hardware frame counter, sampled engine update counter and displayed Mode4 page flips, plus emulated GBA cycle timer; never host FPS
limits: Synthetic host suite owns exhaustive serial wrap and all geometry sets; this suite records only controller-reached cases
counting_note: Checks overlap other suites; do not interpret their sum as unique behaviors.
